events.text:
Honeycomb completed and finished.

**Build:** 7 full bases in a honeycomb (center 0,0,0 + ring of 6) — all level 0.

**Top finish:** `cover:*;full;top` on all 7 cells — refs `cover:-1,0,0;full;top`, `cover:-1,1,0;full;top`, `cover:0,-1,0;full;top`, `cover:0,0,0;full;top`, `cover:0,1,0;full;top`, `cover:1,-1,0;full;top`, `cover:1,0,0;full;top`.

**Perimeter:** 18 caps placed — every outside edge offered by the configurator for this 7-cell cluster was filled:
- `-1,0,0` x3 (90°,150°,210°)
- `-1,1,0` x3 (150°,210°,270°)
- `0,-1,0` x3 (30°,90°,150°)
- `0,1,0` x3 (210°,270°,330°)
- `1,-1,0` x3 (30°,90°,330°)
- `1,0,0` x3 (30°,270°,330°)

`check_build` = meshClash **clear**, no errors; only LOOSE_BODY warning (joint bolts would lock but were not requested and do not affect coverage/capping).
